Inapplicable bounds are null; unknown kinds/IDs denied. All schema artifacts resolve actual protected ArtifactCatalog ID/hash and handler schema registration before enrollment.

closed_resolvers.handler_resolution: Root-only calls resolve current snapshot row and registered fixed handler from exact operation,target,handler_artifact_id+SHA. result_capsules.resolution: Only completed declared dependency node in same job/principal/profile and live lease may supply fields; verify payload hash/schema/source receipt/full closure/current consent/generation. Missing, forged, ambiguous, failed or stale result cannot advance DAG.

These additions are internal only; public process.start schema unchanged. Exact UTF8 prompt bytes from protected body recipe, nonempty <=262144 bytes, no extra newline or shell interpolation.
task_runner_protocol.stdin: Custody root-only write_initial_task_stdin_and_close(task_handle,exact_bytes) verifies live owned process/initial digest/size, writes once with bounded partial-write handling and concurrent bounded output drain, then closes its owned stdin FD to signal EOF. This is completion of the same admitted launch effect, not a later reuse of its grant. No worker close_stdin flag, arbitrary extra writes, FD/PID/path selection or stdin reopening. Partial write/cancel/deadline is failed or ambiguous, never completed.
task_runner_protocol.wait: wait_owned_task_terminal(task_handle:str,deadline_monotonic:float,cancelled:Callable[[],bool])->RootTaskTerminalReceipt; requested deadline may shorten only. Cancellation stops only owned unit and closes FDs. ECHILD/lost custody/restart ambiguity cannot assert exit success or kill unknown PID.
task_runner_protocol.validate: validate_selected_task_result(task_handle:str,terminal_receipt_handle:str)->RootResourceProcessReceipt; root resolves stored actual bounded output bytes and exact selected result_schema_id/validator artifact, requires observed exit 0 plus semantic result validation and native boundary provenance. No worker result bytes/schema/success label accepted. Exit 0 alone is not native functionality proof.

AuthorityService fixed resource operation handlers invoke admission service; no public task-runner verbs or generic process command transport.
